description: Empirical agreement on e_coli_core; does not prove uniformity.

protocol.naja_whiten: rotate+whiten + fixed pair probability .5, adaptive thinning
protocol.backmap: float64 T*z+shift; Naja native stored samples are float32
protocol.wasserstein1: mean absolute difference of sorted empirical samples; equal sample counts
protocol.normalization: pooled reference population standard deviation, including between-reference mean difference
protocol.active_reactions: norm(T[row])>1e-12 and pooled reference std>1e-10*max(1,abs(reference mean))
protocol.correlation_normalization: Frobenius norm divided by number of active reactions (entrywise RMS)
protocol.reference_floor: hopsy2401 vs hopsy1201, separate random seeds
